Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the 30 min intro earlier — good to learn more about BrightRetail's search & personalization priorities for Q2. Quick recap / qualification so we're aligned before scheduling the technical session: 

- Key goals: reduce query latency for basket checkout flows, add reranking for personalized results, and tighten cost-per-thousand-requests to keep margin targets.
- Primary data sensitivity: PII in user profiles and transaction logs; you'll need SOC2 evidence + KMS support.
- Success metric for pilot: 20% latency reduction on the 90th pct and equivalent relevance or better on curated prompts.

Next step: full technical demo + architecture deep dive (60 minutes) with engineering + ops. To make scheduling workable for your US/EU/APAC stakeholders we suggest rotating time slots (so no single region is always outside business hours). Options — please pick any that work or tell us conflicts: 

Option A (EMEA-friendly): Thu 12 Feb 2026 — 14:00 CET / 09:00 ET / 06:00 PT
Option B (US-friendly morning): Thu 12 Feb 2026 — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 CET
Option C (APAC-friendly): Fri 13 Feb 2026 — 09:30 SGT / 02:30 CET / 20:30 PT (we realize this is late for the west coast; rotate only when APAC stakeholders must lead)

Agenda (attached): 10m recap + priorities, 30m live demo (model routing, batching, KV caching), 15m architecture Q&A (networking/KMS), 5m next steps & rollout plan.

If you prefer a recurring weekly slot on a rotating cadence we can propose a two-week rotation that alternates Option A/B so EMEA and US-hosted meetings take turns.

I'll wait for your preferred slot — Priyom, Lauren, want to be aware of any constraints from SE / manager side.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
